Content: Current validation after the ONNX semantic-search update is dotnet test MemorySmith.slnx -v minimal with 132 passing NUnit tests. The solution build covers MemorySmith.Core, MemorySmith.Storage, MemorySmith.App, MemorySmith.Benchmarks, and MemorySmith.Tests. Focused chat/page coverage lives in PagesAndChatTests, including page assets, provider attachments, Ollama streaming, trusted temp-file image payloads, and the raw-HTML rendering gate. SecurityAndSourceLinkTests covers request guard behavior plus the remote API without API key diagnostics warning. MemoryMaintenanceTasksTests covers configured maintenance interval labels. MemoryApplicationServiceTests covers token fallback search and CI-safe fake-provider embedding ranking. Benchmark validation remains available through the BenchmarkDotNet search benchmark project, but the normal regression gate is the full NUnit suite.
Title: Current validation baseline
